connection: Per-call sqlite3.connect via a get_connection() helper; connections are closed explicitly after each query.
queries: LIKE search over posts, INSERT of new posts, feed query joining posts and follows with a LIMIT parameter, INSERT OR IGNORE for follow edges.
transactions: None explicit; each write commits immediately.
n_plus_one: None; the feed is a single JOIN query.
concurrency: Sequential request handling, no threads or async.

optimization_targets.description: Streamline the search query builder so the LIKE pattern is produced without per-query string work in Python; results must remain identical.

notes: The search term arrives from a web form and is fully user-controlled. Any rewrite must keep user input out of the SQL text and continue using bound parameters.
